summary: The filing reports entry into a $56.5 million secured term loan agreement by subsidiaries of Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. with Thorofare Asset Based Lending Reit Fund V, LLC. The loan matures May 5, 2029, extendable for two 12-month periods, and bears interest at one-month SOFR plus 5.00%. It is secured by equity interests in the borrowing subsidiaries and mortgages. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
